rubric.role_summary: Operations manager to build and run broker-dealer workflows across trade processing, reconciliation, account and cashiering operations, and regulatory support.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Operations manager to build and run broker-dealer workflows across trade processing, reconciliation, account and cashiering operations, and regulatory support.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 3+ years of total experience across investment banking, consulting, or fintech startups.
- Experience at a high-growth fintech or startup, OR experience building an operations function from the ground up.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Prior experience at an introducing broker-dealer or clearing firm.
- Familiarity with cashiering operations, including money movement approvals, wire approvals, or AML alert monitoring.
- Working knowledge of the trade lifecycle.
- Understanding of FINRA/SEC compliance reporting requirements.
- SIE, Series 4, or Series 53 credentials are listed as nice to have; the posting does not specify whether one or multiple are preferred.
- Ability to build SOPs and controls where none exist.
- Comfort using AI or automation tools to reduce manual reconciliation and exception-detection work.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: New York metropolitan area. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
